messages:
marta: quick question — integration-tests failing on embeddings ingest. When a batch has mixed items ("", null, long text) and truncation occurs, do we preserve output order and shape? saw a test expecting 1:1 mapping.
kevin: We should always preserve order. Contract: response.data is an array same length as inputs. For null inputs we currently return null. Empty string is a real input -> model returns a vector. Truncation should operate per-item, not drop items.
sara: repro steps? which test failed?
marta: reproducer:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "inputs": ["short", "", null, "<very long string...>"]
}
```
current response:
```
{"data": [[...768 floats...], [...768 floats...], [...768 floats...]]}
```
(note missing null slot)
andrew: that's definitely a bug — we must not coalesce or drop nulls; output array length must equal input length. Also confirm vector dim is stable (e.g., "vector_dim": "768" header or metadata).
kevin: agreed. Options:
- fix service to map null -> null in outputs
- add opt-in param `preserve_nulls=true` if we worry about breaking existing consumers
I prefer changing to preserve by default and bumping minor version in docs.
marta: any perf/batching implications? big concern is internal batching that strips empty slots before model call.
sara: batching pipeline removes nulls to save tokens; we can change to keep placeholders in KV cache and stitch back outputs. Slight cost but correctness trumps.
kevin: batch limits FYI: host API: 1024 items per request; Dedicated: 4096. We should document both. Also truncation cutoff: model tokenizer max tokens 8192, we apply truncation at input pre-tokenization length 8000 to leave headroom.
marta: for QA: add tests for (a) mixed null/empty ordering (b) truncation marker header `x-embed-truncated: true` when any item truncated (c) consistent vector shape (d) large batch (>1024) error vs pagination.
andrew: CR pinged: @andrew please review PR #4321 — adds plumbing + tests.
ops-bot: deploy to staging scheduled 2026-03-18T18:00Z :rocket:
kevin: docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — includes examples and behavior matrix.
marta: thanks team, I'll update issue and attach QA checklist.
